CustomField.inlineHelpText: Non-std or custom tech/IT requests. May involve a variety of systems including TOPS, portals, CDB, galaxy, etc. E.G. solutioning, engagement with multiple areas, capital committee participation. Excludes projects managed or led by others i.e. Solutions Engineer. Medium: Periodic IT/tech customer specific projects throughout the year. High: Extensive, complex IT requests ongoing throughout the year. Multiple PPM Optics request, CRM engagement, etc. requiring solutioning and oversight.
